The Prisma Client

The generated client your code actually calls to talk to the database, and why one shared instance is enough.

  • Generating the Client

    The Prisma Client is generated code, not a hand-written library — regenerated from schema.prisma every time it changes.

  • The Client as a Singleton

    One shared PrismaClient instance for the whole app, for exactly the same reason Lesson 1's controllers needed no DI container.

  • Query Methods

    findMany, findUnique, create — one object per model, named after it, with methods that return Promises.
